authority: This JSON is the sole authored fleet authority. Explicit stored markers are consumed by export; --reflow is an explicit parameter-to-pose authoring action.
randomness: No random scatter. Seed is pinned for future controlled variation; current explicit formation is deterministic.
shipDimensionProvenance: FusionFrigate final LOD0 evaluated source/FBX roundtrip measurement; Unity must independently validate actual imported bounds.
spacingRationale: 5L longitudinal and 4.8L lateral intentionally exceed suggested starting spacing to make actual centre nearest-neighbour median at least twice 51.778373718m. Column zero in each squadron preserves a straight five-ship route; other columns have small deterministic row offsets.

measurements.rockMethod: All-LOD prototype full AABB diagonal x scale plus ship corner radius; deliberately conservative sphere separation, not Unity physics.

routeEstimate.method: Non-optimal reproducible all-120-target column-snake route; 60% cruise distance/40% boost distance, harmonic effective speed; lane turns and alignment plus margin. Estimate, not a completed human playthrough.
